s: Din modim derabbanan ubo g' seipim: kesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur le"modim" — shochin immo hatztzibbur. Vaapillu yachid hammitpallel y"ch — tzarik lashuach immo im hu omed beemtza beraka kemo shennitbaer besiman q"t, kede shello yehe nireh kekoper bemi shechaberayv mishtachavim lo. Velo day bishchiyya muetet, ella keshiur shear shechiyyot shennitbaer besiman qy"g, ubilbad shello yishchu yoter midday kemo shennitbaer sham. Veomerim hatztzibbur "modim" shehu tiqqun harbeh chakamim, veniqra "modim derabbanan". Veyesh omerim shechotemin "baruk atta Hashem el hahodaot". Veyesh omerim shello lachtom. Lepikak nohagin lachtom belo hazkarat hashshem, veomerim "baruk el hahodaot". Veyesh mi sheomer shetztzarik lishchot gam bassop be"al sheanu modim lak". Vetob lachosh lidbarayv. Ubimdinot ellu hamminhag lomar hakkol bishchiyya achat mittechilla vead sop, ap al pi sheyyesh bo hazkara — en lehaqpid mishshum "h' zoqep kepupim" ella besop habberaka o bitchillatah, kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"g:

Yesh meqomot shehakkohanim noseim kappehem bekol yom, veen omerim sham "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"ch. Veim en sham kohanim — tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur lomar birkat kohanim, shehi "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'" ad "vaani abarakem". Ubimdinot ellu en omerim raq ad "shalom". Vaapillu keshehakkohanim noseim kappehem omer otah hashsheliach tzibbur bimdinot ellu, kemo sheyyitbaer sham. Ubizman sheeno rauy linsiut kappayim — en omerim otah, kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"a. Veen hatztzibbur nohagim laanot amen achar birkat kohanim sheomer hashsheliach tzibbur, lepi sheen tzarik laanot amen ella kesheshshomein mippi kohen hambarek. Ella nohagin lomar "ken yehi ratzon" bimqom amen. Yesh nohagin lomar ken besop habberaka bilbad. Veyesh nohagin lomar ken achar kol pasuq. Vehannohagin lomar achar kol pasuq "yehi ratzon" ubesop pasuq g' "ken yehi ratzon" — toim hem, she"yehi ratzon" belo millat "ken" — en mashmaut ezeh dabar "yehi ratzon":

Nahagu bimdinot ellu lomar beshacharit "sim shalom". Veken bekol zeman sheomer "elohenu velohe abotenu ku'". Abal bearbit matchilin "shalom rab". Veken bemincha apillu hashsheliach tzibbur, kesheen omerim "elohenu velohe abotenu ku'". Veyesh matchilin "sim shalom" bemincha shel shabbat, hoil veomerim bo "ki beor paneka natatta lanu", shehi hattora sheqqorin bemincha beshabbat:
